meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计并运行量子电路，模拟噪声效应
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Google 量子硬件上设计噪声感知电路
copy.tagline_en: Design and run quantum circuits, simulate noise effects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design noise-aware circuits for Google quantum hardware

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能用 Python 库 Cirq 设计、模拟和运行量子电路，支持参数扫描、噪声建模、硬件编译，还能在 Google Quantum AI 等后端上执行实验。
howto.when: 当你说要面向 Google 量子硬件、设计含噪声的量子电路，或运行量子表征实验时触发；IBM 硬件场景会用 qiskit 替代。

say.text: 对参数 theta 从 0 到 2π 做 20 点扫描，看测量结果变化。
say.note: Claude 会用参数扫描批量模拟。

say.text: 给电路加 depolarizing 噪声，比较不同噪声率下的结果。
say.note: 会做噪声对比并给出结果统计。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Python library Cirq to design, simulate, and run quantum circuits, with support for parameter sweeps, noise modeling, hardware compilation, and execution on Google Quantum AI and other backends.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about Google quantum hardware, noise-aware circuit design, or quantum characterization experiments; for IBM hardware it will use qiskit instead.

say_en.text: Create a Bell-state circuit with H and CNOT, simulate 1000 shots, and print the histogram.
Sweep parameter theta from 0 to 2π over 20 points and show measurement changes.
Add depolarizing noise to the circuit and compare results at different noise rates.
